title: How is Hitler connected to Big Bird?
description:
Five real photos connect Adolf Hitler to Big Bird from Sesame Street, through Hungary's regent, a future pope, a president and a first lady.

Adolf Hitler → Miklós Horthy → Pope Pius XII → Harry S. Truman → Pat Nixon → Big Bird

How they're connected (every photo is real and sourced):
1. Adolf Hitler → Miklós Horthy: In 1938, Hitler hosted Hungary's ruler, Miklós Horthy, at a warship launch.
   Photo by Ladislav Luppa, Public domain: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Mikl%C3%B3s_Horthy_and_Adolf_Hitler_1938.jpg
2. Miklós Horthy → Pope Pius XII: That year, Horthy greeted the future Pope Pius XII at a Budapest station.
   Photo, Public domain: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Horthy_Mikl%C3%B3s_%C3%A9s_Eugenio_Pacelli_a_Keleti_p%C3%A1lyaudvaron_(K%C3%A9pes_Pesti_H%C3%ADrlap,_1938).jpg
3. Pope Pius XII → Truman: In 1956, the Pope welcomed former president Harry Truman to the Vatican.
   Photo by Associated Press, Public domain: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Pius_XII_with_Harry_and_Bess_Truman,_in_the_Vatican,_1956.jpg
4. Truman → Pat Nixon: In 1969, Truman watched President Nixon play piano beside first lady Pat Nixon.
   Photo by The Nixon library, Public domain: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:President_Richard_Nixon_plays_the_piano_at_the_Truman_Library.jpg
5. Pat Nixon → Big Bird: And in 1970, Pat Nixon's Christmas party had a guest: Big Bird.
   Photo by The Nixon library, Public domain: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Pat_Nixon_and_Big_Bird.jpg

Research notes: Horthy's free photo with Cardinal Pacelli opens the way west; Pius XII also received the Nixons in 1957, but no free photo of that audience turned up, so the chain crosses through his 1956 audience with Harry Truman.

Give me two names in the comments and I'll find the photos that connect them.

#adolfhitler #bigbird #sixdegrees #history #didyouknow #shorts
first_comment:
Fun fact from the research: At the 1970 diplomats' children's Christmas party, Pat Nixon reportedly walked the East Room with two of Big Bird's yellow feathers tucked into her diamond brooch.

Who should Hitler connect to next? Name anyone (a character works too) and I'll find the photos.
